review_article:
Apps Built With AI Review 2026 — My Honest Take After Testing Justin Burns' No-Code System

Let me be direct: Apps Built With AI launches on JVZoo on May 15, 2026. Justin Burns — TEDx speaker, creator of Miestro (30,000+ customers, sold the business), and one of the most credible names in the "build with AI" space — is behind it. That earns attention.

I dug deep into the full funnel and real student results. Here's exactly what you get, what the upsells cost, and whether the $27 front-end is worth it.

What Is Apps Built With AI?

Apps Built With AI is a step-by-step system for non-technical entrepreneurs to build real software and apps using AI — no coding skills, no $100K development team, no CS degree required.

The premise: AI tools have made it possible for anyone to describe what they want and have an app built for them. The gap isn't technical anymore. It's knowing what to build, how to validate it, and how to launch it profitably. That's exactly what this system addresses.

Who Is Justin Burns?

Justin Burns is a TEDx speaker and the founder of Apps Built With AI. Before this, he built Miestro — a membership and course platform — scaled it to 30,000+ customers, and sold it. His recent JVZoo launches: $800K+ across just two products. Student revenue from ABWAI: $3M+ combined. Active builders in the community: 500+.

What You Get for $27 — 6 Components + Live Event Ticket

The front-end includes 6 components with a total stated value of $1,482. You pay $27:

  • 45-Min Mini Training ($297 value) — Plan, build, and launch a real software product in a single day
  • Ultimate GPT Niche Finder ($297 value) — Uncover profitable, underserved markets and validate demand before you build
  • Top 50 App Ideas PDF ($97 value) — Proven micro-SaaS ideas with target market, pricing model, and build path
  • AI Software Prompt Creator ($297 value) — Pre-engineered prompts for apps, logins, dashboards, payments, and deploys
  • Software Waitlist Prompt ($297 value) — Landing page + email capture + copy that fills your waitlist before you build
  • Walkthrough Prompt Videos ($197 value) — Every prompt used in real time, watch-over-my-shoulder format
  • Free Ticket to the 3-Day Build Apps With AI Challenge — Live event seat included

Real Student Results

The documented results stand out:

  • Marcus — former Uber driver, now earning $22,000/month from an app he built with this system
  • Sarah — full-time nurse, earning $2,300/month in side income from her app

These are specific numbers, not stock-photo testimonials. Combined with $3M+ in verified student revenue, this is one of the better-documented results cases at this price point.

The Upsells — What Each One Does

OTO 1 — VIP Summit Platinum ($49): Upgrade to Platinum for the live ABWAI VIP Summit. Includes VIP-only night-before call with Justin, live Q&A, lifetime access to all summit replays, and the VIP Resource Portal with workbooks, prompts, templates, and GPTs.

OTO 2 — AppsBuilt Monthly ($49/mo): The recurring membership. Includes software to build an app, live training calls every two weeks, on-demand training library updated monthly, 24/7 community with direct access to Justin, and a premium template vault. As an affiliate, you earn 50% on every monthly payment as long as the customer is subscribed.

OTO 3 — 1-on-1 Strategy Session + Full Course ($197): A private 60-minute session with a certified ABWAI app strategist, plus the full course. Includes pre-session app idea audit, custom Product Specification Sheet, personalized 90-day launch plan, and a recording with transcript.

Verdict

At $27 for 6 components plus a live event ticket, this is a strong entry point. Justin Burns has the track record: $800K+ in recent launches, $3M+ in student revenue, 30,000+ Miestro customers. Marcus at $22K/month and Sarah at $2,300/month make the case without hype.

The front-end stands on its own. OTO 2 ($49/mo) is where serious builders should go — the recurring membership with live calls and community is where ongoing progress happens. Rating: 4.6/5. Launch window closes May 22, 2026.
